settings.page.title: Settings
settings.easy_mode.title: Simple Mode
settings.easy_magic_book_collection.desc: When enabled, Magic Book Collection automatically removes a random card from the lowest rarity group and shuffles a random Magic Book into your draw pile.
settings.easy_read_look.label: Simple Read - Look
settings.easy_read_look.description: When enabled, Read no longer shows up to 3 cards from the top of your draw pile, and instead chooses the top card by default.
settings.easy_read_put.label: Simple Read - Return
settings.easy_read_put.description: When enabled, Read no longer asks which card to return to the bottom of your draw pile, and instead returns the leftmost eligible card in your hand.
